_comment: Shown in the main menu (Options > Credits). Third-party assets and their licences; keep in step with legion/assets/CREDITS.md. A line may hold links as [url=https://...]short label[/url]: the label is shown (never a raw address, which wraps mid-path), the address is its tooltip, and a click opens it.

sections.title: Legion
lines: Card art, table and menu backgrounds and the soundtrack: supplied by the Legion team.
Sound effects: generated for Legion with [url=https://elevenlabs.io/sound-effects]ElevenLabs Sound Effects[/url], November 2026.
Painted card backs (Crimson Wyrm, Verdant Grove, Abyssal Tide, Obsidian Runes, Gilded Sun, Arcane Starfield): generated for Legion with GPT Image 2 through ElevenLabs, November 2026.

Art for six cards added on 10 November 2026 (Mithral Dome, A Great Heist, Trap Hole of Suppression, Trap Hole of Spikes, Divine Serpent - Tail, The Great Leviathan): generated for Legion with GPT Image 2.5 from the team's existing card art as style reference, picked by the Legion team.

Art for six cards added on 17 November 2026 (Muscle of the Marked Claw, Angered Komodo, Bloodlust Komodo, Heretic of the Divine Order, Soul of Burning Revenge, Zadus The Disavowed): generated the same way and picked by the Legion team.

sections.title: Status icons
lines: From [url=https://game-icons.net]game-icons.net[/url], licensed under [url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/]Creative Commons Attribution 3.0[/url] (CC BY 3.0).
Lorc: rune stone, anchor, ankh, broadhead arrow, hood, sprint, semi-closed eye, cracked shield.
Delapouite: sparkles. Zeromancer: heart plus. Carl Olsen: flame. Skoll: pentacle, sight disabled. Darkzaitzev: death juice.
The glyphs are set, outlined and shaded, on enamelled badges made for Legion (the Paralyse bolt and the Cleanse sparkle are Legion's own).

sections.title: Surface textures
lines: Leather032, Leather030, Wood051 and Metal009 from [url=https://ambientcg.com]ambientCG[/url], licensed under [url=https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/]CC0 1.0[/url].
Converted to greyscale relief maps for the interface.
